LanguageData.LP_Larloch.label: retinue of Larloch the Shadow King
LanguageData.LP_Larloch.description: Larloch the Shadow King is one of the oldest liches to survive the fall of Netheril, hiding in the tomb of Warlock's Crypt collecting Netherese relics. His retinue is demiliches and skeletons.
LanguageData.LP_Larloch.fixedName: retinue of Larloch the Shadow King
LanguageData.LP_Larloch.ideoDescription: The legacy of Netheril belongs only to those worthy of it.
